race.comment: HOLY HOLY HOLY (5) hadn't been far away prior to finishing 4.5 lengths adrift in seventh last start over 1280m at Emerald. Should be poised just off the lead and is likely to feature in the finish. TAHKIAN BUBBLES (1) finished fourth last time out over 1200m at Betoota, beaten only 1.75 lengths. Everything points to a big run. ARMSTRONG BAY (4) was out of the money two runs back then again missed the frame last start over 1280m at Emerald, beaten 5.5 lengths into eighth. Well placed in this contest and there is no reason why he cannot find winning ways. VALIANT JOAN (11) continues to race well and has to be included from the soft draw.
